songs.title: A Red, Red Rose
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
O my [G]luve's like a red, red rose
That's [C]newly sprung in [G]June
O my [G]luve's like the melody
That's [D]sweetly played in [G]tune

[Verse 2]
As [G]fair art thou, my bonnie lass
So [C]deep in luve am [G]I
And I [G]will luve thee still, my dear
Till [D]a' the seas gang [G]dry

[Verse 3]
Till [G]a' the seas gang dry, my dear
And the [C]rocks melt wi' the [G]sun
I will [G]luve thee still, my dear
While the [D]sands o' life shall [G]run

[Verse 4]
And [G]fare thee weel, my only luve
And [C]fare thee weel a [G]while
And I [G]will come again, my luve
Tho' it [D]were ten thousand [G]mile

songs.title: Annie Laurie
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
[D]Maxwellton braes are bonnie
Where [G]early fa's the [D]dew
And it's [D]there that Annie Laurie
Gie'd [A]me her promise [D]true
Gie'd [D]me her promise true
Which [G]ne'er forgot will [D]be
And for [G]bonnie Annie [D]Laurie
I'd [A]lay me doun and [D]dee

[Verse 2]
Her [D]brow is like the snowdrift
Her [G]throat is like the [D]swan
Her [D]face it is the fairest
That [A]e'er the sun shone [D]on
That [D]e'er the sun shone on
And [G]dark blue is her [D]e'e
And for [G]bonnie Annie [D]Laurie
I'd [A]lay me doun and [D]dee

[Verse 3]
Like [D]dew on the gowan lying
Is the [G]fa' o' her fairy [D]feet
And like [D]winds in summer sighing
Her [A]voice is low and [D]sweet
Her [D]voice is low and sweet
And she's [G]a' the world to [D]me
And for [G]bonnie Annie [D]Laurie
I'd [A]lay me doun and [D]dee

songs.title: Comin' Thro' the Rye
songs.source: Robert Burns, from older song (public domain); original chart
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
Gin a [G]body meet a body
[C]Comin' thro' the [G]rye
Gin a [G]body kiss a body
[D]Need a body [G]cry

[Chorus]
[G]Ilka lassie has her laddie
[C]Nane, they say, hae [G]I
Yet [G]a' the lads they smile at me
When [D]comin' thro' the [G]rye

[Verse 2]
Gin a [G]body meet a body
[C]Comin' frae the [G]town
Gin a [G]body greet a body
[D]Need a body [G]frown

[Verse 3]
A[G]mang the train there is a swain
I [C]dearly lo'e my[G]sel'
But [G]what's his name, or where's his hame
I [D]dinna care to [G]tell

songs.title: The Ash Grove
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
The [G]ash grove, how graceful, how [C]plainly 'tis [G]speaking
The [C]wind through it [G]playing has [D]charmed all my [G]cares
The [G]ash grove, how graceful, how [C]plainly 'tis [G]speaking
The [C]wind through it [G]playing has [D]charmed all my [G]cares

[Verse 2]
Down [G]yonder, the green grove a[C]lone in its [G]splendor
Where [C]once I found [G]pleasure, now [D]faded and [G]gone
Are [G]the friends of my childhood, I [C]think of them [G]ever
The [C]days of my [G]youth I re[D]member with [G]song

[Verse 3]
My [G]laughter is over, my [C]step loses [G]lightness
Old [C]age it is [G]coming, my [D]youth is no [G]more
The [G]leaves they are falling, the [C]ash grove is [G]calling
And [C]I must de[G]part for the [D]land of the [G]dead

songs.title: All Through the Night
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
Sleep, my [G]child, and [C]peace at[G]tend thee
All through the [D]night
Guardian [G]angels [C]God will [G]send thee
All through the [D]night
Soft the drowsy [C]hours are creeping
Hill and vale in [G]slumber [D]steeping
I my loving [G]vigil [C]keep[G]ing
All through the [D]night  [G]

[Verse 2]
While the [G]moon her [C]watch is [G]keeping
All through the [D]night
While the [G]weary [C]world is [G]sleeping
All through the [D]night
O'er thy spirit [C]gently stealing
Visions of de[G]light re[D]vealing
Breathes a pure and [G]holy [C]feel[G]ing
All through the [D]night  [G]

songs.body:

Ay, ay, ay, [C]ay

songs.title: La Cucaracha
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
La cuca[C]racha, la cucaracha

[Verse 2]
La cuca[C]racha, la cucaracha
Ya no puede cami[G]nar

[Verse 3]

songs.title: Beautiful Dreamer
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
[D]Beautiful dreamer, [A]wake unto me
[A]Starlight and dewdrops are [D]waiting for thee
[D]Sounds of the rude world [A]heard in the day
[A]Lulled by the moonlight have [D]all passed away

[Verse 2]
[D]Beautiful dreamer, [G]queen of my song
[A]List while I woo thee with [D]soft melody
[D]Gone are the cares of [A]life's busy throng
[A]Beautiful dreamer, a[D]wake unto me
[A]Beautiful dreamer, a[D]wake unto me

[Verse 3]
[D]Beautiful dreamer, [A]out on the sea
[A]Mermaids are chanting the [D]wild lorelei
[D]Over the streamlet [A]vapors are borne
[A]Waiting to fade at the [D]bright coming morn

songs.title: Jeanie with the Light Brown Hair
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
I [F]dream of Jeanie with the [C]light brown [F]hair
Borne like a [C]vapor on the [F]summer [C]air
I [F]long for Jeanie with the [C]day-dawn [F]smile
Radiant in [C]gladness, warm with [F]winning [C]guile

[Verse 2]
I [F]sigh for Jeanie, but her [C]voice is [F]still
Borne like a [C]vapor on the [F]summer [C]air
I [F]sigh for Jeanie, but her [C]form is [F]gone
Radiant in [C]gladness, warm with [F]winning [C]guile
I [F]dream of Jeanie with the [C]light brown [F]hair

songs.title: Hard Times Come Again No More
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
Let us [G]pause in life's pleasures and [C]count its many [G]tears
While we [G]all sup sorrow with the [D]poor
There's a [G]song that will linger for[C]ever in our [G]ears
Oh, [G]hard times, come again no [D]more  [G]

[Chorus]
'Tis the [G]song, the sigh of the weary
[C]Hard times, hard times, come again no [G]more
Many [G]days you have lingered a[C]round my cabin [G]door
Oh, [G]hard times, come again no [D]more  [G]

[Verse 2]
While we [G]seek mirth and beauty and [C]music light and [G]gay
There are [G]frail forms fainting at the [D]door
Though their [G]voices are silent, their [C]pleading looks will [G]say
Oh, [G]hard times, come again no [D]more  [G]

songs.title: Battle Hymn of the Republic
songs.source: Julia Ward Howe, 1862 (public domain); original chart
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
Mine [G]eyes have seen the glory of the coming of the Lord
He is [C]trampling out the vintage where the grapes of wrath are [G]stored
He hath [G]loosed the fateful lightning of His terrible swift sword
His [D]truth is marching [G]on

[Chorus]
[G]Glory, glory, hallelujah
[C]Glory, glory, halle[G]lujah
[G]Glory, glory, hallelujah
His [D]truth is marching [G]on

[Verse 2]
I have [G]seen Him in the watch-fires of a hundred circling camps
They have [C]builded Him an altar in the evening dews and [G]damps
I can [G]read His righteous sentence by the dim and flaring lamps
His [D]day is marching [G]on

[Verse 3]
He has [G]sounded forth the trumpet that shall never call retreat
He is [C]sifting out the hearts of men before His judgment [G]seat
Oh, be [G]swift, my soul, to answer Him; be jubilant, my feet
Our [D]God is marching [G]on

songs.title: America the Beautiful
songs.source: Katharine Lee Bates / Samuel A. Ward (public domain); original chart
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
O [G]beautiful for spacious skies
For [C]amber waves of [G]grain
For purple mountain majesties
A[D]bove the fruited [G]plain
A[G]merica, A[C]meri[G]ca
God [D]shed His grace on [G]thee
And [C]crown thy good with [G]brotherhood
From [D]sea to shining [G]sea

[Verse 2]
O [G]beautiful for pilgrim feet
Whose [C]stern, impassioned [G]stress
A thoroughfare for freedom beat
A[D]cross the wilder[G]ness
A[G]merica, A[C]meri[G]ca
God [D]mend thine every [G]flaw
Con[C]firm thy soul in [G]self-control
Thy [D]liberty in [G]law

[Verse 3]
O [G]beautiful for patriot dream
That [C]sees beyond the [G]years
Thine alabaster cities gleam
Un[D]dimmed by human [G]tears
A[G]merica, A[C]meri[G]ca
God [D]shed His grace on [G]thee
And [C]crown thy good with [G]brotherhood
From [D]sea to shining [G]sea

songs.title: My Country, 'Tis of Thee
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
My [G]country, 'tis of thee
Sweet [C]land of [G]liberty
Of [D]thee I [G]sing
Land where my [C]fathers [G]died
Land of the [C]pilgrim's [G]pride
From every [C]mountain [G]side
Let [D]freedom [G]ring

[Verse 2]
My [G]native country, thee
Land [C]of the [G]noble free
Thy [D]name I [G]love
I love thy [C]rocks and [G]rills
Thy woods and [C]templed [G]hills
My heart with [C]rapture [G]thrills
Like [D]that a[G]bove

[Verse 3]
Let [G]music swell the breeze
And [C]ring from [G]all the trees
Sweet [D]freedom's [G]song
Let mortal [C]tongues a[G]wake
Let all that [C]breathe par[G]take
Let rocks their [C]silence [G]break

songs.title: Turkey in the Straw
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
As I was a-[G]going down the road

Turkey in the [D]straw, turkey in the hay
Roll 'em up and twist 'em up a high tuck-a-[G]haw

[Verse 2]
Went out to [G]milk and I didn't know how

A-winking at his mother-in-[D]law  [G]

songs.body:
[Verse 1]

'Twas [A]The Arkansas Traveler that he played by [D]ear

[Verse 2]

And [A]stopped to listen what the old man would play
The [D]old man went on with his "rat-a-tat-tat"
And [A]kept on playing, sitting on his old [D]hat

[Verse 3]
[D]How do you do, neighbor, won't you let me in
I [A]want to get out of this awful rain

There's [A]plenty of room in this old [D]house

songs.title: Sweet Betsy from Pike
songs.body:
[Verse 1]
Did you [C]ever hear tell of Sweet Betsy from Pike

With two yoke of cattle, a large yellow dog
A [G]tall Shanghai rooster, and one spotted [C]hog

[Chorus]
Sing[C]ing too-ra-li-oo-ra-li-oo-ra-li-[G]ay
Singing too-ra-li-oo-ra-li-oo-ra-li-[C]ay

[Verse 2]
One [C]evening quite early they camped on the Platte
'Twas [G]near by the road on a green shady [C]flat
Where Betsy, quite tired, lay down to repose
While [G]Ike gazed with wonder on his Pike County [C]rose

[Verse 3]
They [C]soon reached the desert, where Betsy gave out
And [G]down in the sand she lay rolling a[C]bout
While Ike, in great tears, looked on in surprise
Saying [G]Betsy, get up, you'll get sand in your [C]eyes
